body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> MSI showcased its flagship audio video entertainment notebook 'MSI Bravo EX620' during CES 2009, which is equipped with a unique Cinema Pro Technology for bringing cinema-level sensory enjoyment.
The Bravo EX620 is also designed to shake-up the market with its ultimate audio and video performance.
